name: René Repasi - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on the 28th Regime: a new legal framework for innovative companies
part_text:
The European Parliament asks the European Commission to propose a new company form called the "Unified European Company" (S.EU). Companies could choose it voluntarily, and it would be recognised in all 27 member states. It would be a limited liability company, not listed on the stock market, with the same core rules everywhere. Registration would be fully digital and take no more than 48 hours. Strong safeguards would keep national labour law and worker participation rights intact. The Commission should table a proposal by the first quarter of 2026.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only requests a Commission proposal for a new optional company form with shared rules.
- **Who it affects:** Small and medium businesses, start-ups and scale-ups that want to operate across several member states.
- **What happens next:** The Commission should propose a directive by early 2026; Parliament and member states then decide.
